svg.title: Lossless: authoring time limits and measured kernel performance

cc:Work.dc:title: Lossless: authoring time limits and measured kernel performance
cc:Work.dc:description: Five-minute pilot: 0 of 3 authors completed, kernel speed unmeasured. Thirty-minute cap: 3 of 3 completed in 6:50, 10:08, 7:21. Selected kernels measured 1.210x, 1.206x, 1.207x retained speed across nine held-out cases each. All nine proposed kernels passed numerical checks. Search cost 25.0 minutes across three LLM runs; search-only payback 6.8 million to 1.19 billion calls. Fresh sessions, not a measured scaling curve.
